source.verification: Institutional PDF extracted text and table markup cross-checked with narrative results and Fig. 2 caption/labels. Web page screenshots attempted but cache miss; no visual table verification or original individual records.

boundary: Source: late August/early September releases both years, monitoring weeks 2,4,8,12,16 then March, July or September following year; exact matched terminal horizons unresolved.

Percentages in Table 3 are rounded station means; equal initial station counts within species; use published proportions, do not reconstruct integer counts from rounded numbers. Exact post-removal seedling counts only from results text.

Primary-cache distance n agrees approximately with per-release cache percentages, but complete missing fate partition and exact linked cache cohorts are unavailable. Do not use these n values as proof of complete primary-cache denominator. No conditional cache survival inference.

Observed total establishment means sum of mutually exclusive recorded establishment at station and after removal, not verified total latent recruitment. Unknown after-removal fate count unavailable. No cohort-specific mortality of all removed seeds. Source records radicle regeneration that may produce seedlings without the original whole seed; retain author-reported seedling establishment, not exact plant demography.

Two years, one landscape, different species stations, measured community seed rain/capture summaries, no causal resource or animal-density effect. Rodent trapping September/December, not necessarily prior to release.
